description: A new --shadow-mode CLI flag is declared but never consumed; extend two files so it controls the output path.
prompt: Add a new --shadow-mode flag in cli/args.py and wire it through so that, when true, src/output.py writes to a file named 'shadow.log' instead of 'prod.log'. Add at least one test in tests/test_output.py that covers the shadow path. Do NOT touch legacy/shadow_old.py — that module is retired.

regex_checks.reason: output file must consult shadow flag
test must exercise the shadow path

must_not_claim: every caller now honours the flag
